summary: The prepared main branch still sized KV pools from the entire profiled byte budget and allocated the request-scaled legacy AITER workspace afterward. The issue-shaped deterministic reproduction overcommitted the budget by 69,793,139,393 bytes. The correction shares the backend's exact workspace formula and binary-searches the real pool configurator/request resolver so KV pools plus workspace fit the profiled budget, including explicit request limits and aligned or architecture-specific pool sizing.

tests.what_was_measured: Before the correction, the checked-out _resolve_memory_pool_config assigned all 219721119039 profiled bytes to 2235118 KV tokens, then derived 4096 requests and a 69793218560-byte AITER workspace, exceeding the budget by 69793139393 bytes. Raw output: reports/j-74d16fc2971b/reproduce_before.log.

After the correction, the same resolver fixture selected 1669878 KV tokens and 3261 requests; KV plus the 55565352960-byte workspace used 219721039872 bytes, leaving 79167 bytes of conservative headroom. Raw output: reports/j-74d16fc2971b/reproduce_after.log.

45 tests and 9 subtests passed, covering the issue-shaped budget, exact backend formula, request floor and ceiling, an explicit request limit, and existing pool configurator behavior. Raw output: reports/j-74d16fc2971b/unit_and_pool_after.log.

On the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 GPU, allocated exactly 65495040 uint8 workspace bytes computed by the shared production helper and verified writes at the first and last byte. Raw output: reports/j-74d16fc2971b/gpu_workspace_check.log.
All changed Python sources and retained evidence scripts compiled successfully.

gpu_execution.evidence: reports/j-74d16fc2971b/gpu_workspace_check.log records an exact 65495040-byte allocation and boundary writes on AMD Instinct MI350X, gcn_arch_name gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-.

remaining_limitations: The reported Qwen3-30B-A3B weights were not available, so no full serving-path or model startup reproduction was claimed.

The assigned GPU is one 252 GiB MI350X gfx950, not the report's 288 GiB MI355X; the retained reproduction validates the current resolver's byte arithmetic and the GPU check validates actual allocation sizing only.
No multi-GPU or distributed workload was exercised.
The prepared environment does not include ruff or black, so those optional formatter commands could not run; git diff --check and compileall passed.
